bio: Welcome to Harvard! I'm thrilled to join the proctor team and be part of your first-year experience. I'm originally from San Antonio, Texas, and I graduated from Stanford University in 2019 where I studied in International Relations and Economics. Prior to starting law school, I worked in consulting in New York and Austin, and also spent a year teaching (and traveling) in Madrid. I love cooking, working on my inversions in yoga class, and searching for the best vanilla latte. I look forward to meeting you all and supporting you as you begin this exciting chapter at Harvard!
